question: Khusrau was the son of which Mughal emperor?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jahangir**__.

__
 
• **Khusrau Mirza** was the eldest **son of the Mughal emperor Jahangir**.** **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Khusrau married the daughter of **Azam Khan Koka.** He had three **sons, Buland Akhtar, Dawar Bakhsh, and Gurshasp**.
 
• **His mother Manbai or Shah Begam **was a Kachhwaha princess and the **daughter of Raja Bhagwant Das**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Akbar** is the greatest of the Mughal emperors of India. He reigned from 1556 to 1605 and extended Mughal power over most of the Indian subcontinent. He was the son of Humayun and the Grandson of Babur.
 
• **Shah Jahan **also called (until 1628) Prince Khurram is the Mughal emperor of India from 1628–58. He built the Taj Mahal.
 
 
• He was the third son of the Mughal emperor Jahangir and the Rajput princess Manati.
 
 
 
• **Jahangir** original named **Nur-ud-din Muhammad Salim** is the Mughal emperor of India from 1605 to 1627.
 
 
• **Prince Salim **was the eldest son of the emperor **Akbar**.
 
 
 
• **Bahadur Shah-I **ascended himself on the throne in **1707** after killing his two brothers and defeating Kam Baksh in the **Battle of Jajau**.
 
• He was the last Mughal who enjoyed all the authority in real terms.
 
• He was popularly known as **Shah Alam I** and called **Shahi-i- Bekhabar** by **Khafi Khan**.
